title: Crop Change & Farmland Dynamics
subtitle: Inter-annual parcel transitions (AY 2023-24 vs AY 2025-26)
key_finding: 53.4% of paddy and 1.3% of banana parcels remained stable between 2023 and 2026. A net 120.3 ha (4.0%) transitioned from paddy to commercial banana, reflecting high-value crop diversification.

Stable Paddy.desc: Paddy in both AY 23-24 and AY 25-26

Paddy \u2192 Banana.desc: Diversification from annual paddy to perennial banana

Banana \u2192 Paddy.desc: Banana replanting cycle / rotation back to paddy

Cropland \u2192 Fallow/Loss.desc: Cultivated land converted to fallow or non-agricultural use

method: Cross-tabulation of independent Random Forest predictions for AY 2023-24 and AY 2025-26. Only pixels with posterior class probability ≥ 0.6 in both agricultural years are evaluated to prevent spurious noise and artifact-induced transitions.
limitations: Banana plantations with ratoon cycles lasting 3–4 years may show slight optical reflectance dips during desuckering/pseudostem harvest without genuine crop change.
